author: murchadha
quote: not for me. the game mechanics are improved with more detail carrying over from red dead redemption 2, but the story is very limiting and there isn't an option to dump lucia, i find her really boring. if a dating sim is what the developers wanted, while staying away from hookers - there should be the option to date other characters that dont nescessarily have to be playable. whoever created lucia as a self insert on the design team needs to learn love themself first instead of forcing us all to put up with her.
